note: The terms check for each source beyond the job boards (reader/NOTES_SEC_AND_DNS_TERMS_2026-11-11.md stays private). An owner script reads a source only when it's allowed here from a check made in the last 45 days, and DATA.md says what each check found.

conditions: Every request carries a User-Agent with a name and a contact address, read from a private file that never ships.
Requests stay far under ten a second, and a throttled run stops and waits at least ten minutes before it starts again.
No request goes under /cgi-bin, so the browse-edgar search is never used.
The page shows no SEC seal or logo and nothing that suggests an SEC or EDGAR business.
data.sec.gov is read by the owner script alone and never by the page.
Form D data keeps the offering fields alone. No related person, signer or recipient is ever saved.
Lookups go slowly through the machine's own resolver.
A finding reads as what a domain's DNS named on the day it was read and never as what a company uses.
A verification record shows a vendor was set up at some point, and the page says so.
No verification token is stored or shown, only the vendor its prefix names.
